subject: general
question: Five boys Sanjay, John, Rahim, Kabir and Aman are standing in a queue facing towards the North. Only one boy is standing behind Kabir. Sanjay is standing just behind John and just in front of Kabir. Aman is at the last position in the queue. Who is standing at the first position in the queue?
solution:
Given:

 
• 
 
Five boys Sanjay, John, Rahim, Kabir and Aman are standing in a queue facing towards the North.

 
1) Only one boy is standing behind Kabir.

 
2) Sanjay is standing just behind John and just in front of Kabir.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/71a2f55f3a4077c420c2c0667aa668494f4158eb9b22699a783b9e9d4969b849.png] 

 
• 
 
3) Aman is at the last position in the queue.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3990aed0a526434ebe2150ae10c11b6d19142fe0a2fdaf3635cd3fc00eae9e03.png] 

 
• Only Rahim is left so:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/61b898b8c99405b2002f7e633abf664b5591577d6336fb586ec97c8d7c11aa8b.png] 

Hence, "Rahim" is standing at the first position in the queue.
